summary: Axonex AI Group Limited, a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer listed in Hong Kong, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that its board adopted unanimous written resolutions on November 3, 2026 to change the authorized share capital from 112,000,000 no-par shares (100,800,000 Class A and 11,200,000 Class B) to an unlimited number of Class A and Class B shares. The Sixth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association, effecting only that change, was filed with the BVI Registrar and became effective November 4, 2026. No transaction, pricing, advisor, or recommendation is stated; the filing is a routine charter amendment.
